evals.prompt: Generate web and mobile icons from demo-icon.png with 5% padding and a white background, saved in output/test-icons-web-mobile
evals.expected_output: Web and mobile icon sets generated in output/test-icons-web-mobile including favicon.ico, android mipmaps, and iOS AppIcon set

evals.prompt: Convert demo-icon.png to WebP format with custom width 256 and height 256 and quality 85 saving to output/demo-256.webp
evals.expected_output: Converted image saved at output/demo-256.webp with 256x256 dimensions

evals.prompt: Create desktop icon sets for both light and dark mode from demo-icon.png with 10% border radius in output/desktop-icons
